verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say Zoho Books automatically imports bank-feed transactions and categorises them, and that its AI handles "categorizing bank statements." The banking API also exposes user-defined Bank Rules and categorization endpoints. Nothing shows suggestions that adapt from the user's corrections; the rules are configured manually rather than learned. missing for 10: evidence of learning from corrections, documentation of how categorization suggestions are generated and presented, independent or hands-on corroboration.
